[My value is $27, which is outside the typical range of $0-$20. I should bid aggressively, but not too aggressively. I want to win if the other bidders are bidding according to the usual value range. [My value is $14. In the ascending clock stage, I want to stay in as long as the clock price is below my value. Therefore, I want my sealed bid to be equal to my value. This way, I will only exit when the clock reaches my value, ensuring I win if the other bidders value the item less than me and I don't overpay. I will bid my value of $14.]
